bbq-sausage-loaded-potatoes.title: BBQ Sausage Loaded Potatoes
bbq-sausage-loaded-potatoes.subtitle: Crispy potatoes with BBQ sausages

method.title: Preheat and toss
method.text: Preheat oven to 425°F (air fryer to 400°F). Toss potatoes with oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.

method.title: Roast potatoes
method.text: Spread on a baking sheet and roast 20–25 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crispy.

method.title: Cook sausages
method.text: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook sausages 8–10 minutes until browned and cooked through, then slice.

method.title: Assemble and melt
method.text: Top potatoes with sliced sausages and grated cheddar. Return to the oven 2–3 minutes until cheese melts.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Drizzle with BBQ sauce, add a dollop of sour cream or mayo and sprinkle scallions on top. Serve immediately.

bbq-sausage-loaded-potatoes.tip: Add jalapeños or use mozzarella instead of cheddar for a different twist.

buffalo-chicken-quesadillas.title: Buffalo Chicken Quesadillas
buffalo-chicken-quesadillas.subtitle: Spicy, cheesy and ready fast

method.title: prep chicken
method.text: Trim and cut chicken into small pieces, season with salt, pepper and a little garlic powder.

method.title: cook chicken
method.text: Cook chicken in a skillet over medium heat until no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.

method.title: make filling
method.text: Mix cooked chicken with hot sauce and cream cheese until creamy, then stir in some chopped red onion.

method.title: assemble quesadillas
method.text: Spread filling and a sprinkle of cheese on a tortilla, top with another tortilla and press to seal.

method.title: cook & serve
method.text: Cook 2-3 minutes per side in a dry skillet until golden and cheese melts. Slice, drizzle with ranch and scatter cilantro.

buffalo-chicken-quesadillas.tip: Use leftover or rotisserie chicken to cut prep time.

cheesy-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.title: Cheesy BBQ Loaded Fries
cheesy-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.subtitle: Crispy fries topped with BBQ chicken

method.title: Cook fries
method.text: Cook fries according to package instructions until golden and crispy.

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Toss shredded chicken with smoked paprika, garlic granules, oil and 2 tbsp BBQ sauce.

method.title: Assemble fries
method.text: Pile cooked fries into an oven-safe dish and top with the BBQ chicken.

method.title: Melt cheese
method.text: Scatter both cheeses over the chicken, then broil or bake a few minutes until melted.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Drizzle remaining BBQ sauce, dollop sour cream, and scatter scallions and fried onions.

cheesy-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.tip: Add sliced jalapeños for heat and an extra drizzle of BBQ sauce if you like it saucy.

cheesy-bbq-loaded-potatoes.title: Cheesy BBQ Loaded Potatoes
cheesy-bbq-loaded-potatoes.subtitle: with chicken and crispy onions

method.title: prepare potatoes
method.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Rub potatoes with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and bake 35–45 minutes until soft.

method.title: mix chicken
method.text: Shred the cooked chicken and toss with 2 tbsp BBQ sauce in a bowl.

method.title: open potatoes
method.text: Slice open baked potatoes lengthwise and fluff the centers with a fork.

method.title: top and melt
method.text: Fill each potato with BBQ chicken, spoon over remaining sauce, sprinkle with cheddar and bake 5 minutes.

method.title: finish and serve
method.text: Top with red onion, crispy fried onions, scallions and a dollop of mayo or sour cream. Serve hot.

cheesy-bbq-loaded-potatoes.tip: Swap chicken for leftover pulled pork or beans for a cheaper twist.

cheesy-bbq-pulled-chicken-nachos.title: Cheesy BBQ Pulled Chicken Nachos
cheesy-bbq-pulled-chicken-nachos.subtitle: Loaded, gooey nachos to share

method.title: Preheat oven
method.text: Heat oven to 400°F.

method.title: Layer chips
method.text: Spread tortilla chips in an even layer on a large baking sheet or ovenproof dish.

method.title: Add toppings
method.text: Toss chicken with half the BBQ sauce, then scatter over chips with red onion and sweet corn.

method.title: Add cheese
method.text: Sprinkle cheddar and torn mozzarella evenly over the nachos.

method.title: Bake and finish
method.text: Bake 8–10 minutes until cheese melts. Drizzle remaining BBQ sauce, dollop sour cream, and sprinkle scallions.

cheesy-bbq-pulled-chicken-nachos.tip: Warm the chicken in BBQ sauce first for more flavor and quicker assembly.

cheesy-beef-bean-loaded-potatoes.title: Cheesy Beef & Bean Loaded Potatoes
cheesy-beef-bean-loaded-potatoes.subtitle: Hearty cheesy loaded potatoes

method.title: Bake potatoes
method.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Bake potatoes 60-70 minutes, or microwave until soft and cooked through.

method.title: Cook beef
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet, cook chopped onion 3-4 minutes until soft, then add ground beef and brown well.

method.title: Add flavor
method.text: Stir in paprika, baked beans and salsa. Simmer 5-10 minutes until thickened. Season to taste.

method.title: Prep potatoes
method.text: Split the baked potatoes and use a fork to fluff the centers.

method.title: Assemble & serve
method.text: Spoon beef and bean mix over potatoes, top with cheddar and scatter scallion. Serve hot.

cheesy-beef-bean-loaded-potatoes.tip: Pop under the broiler for a minute to make the cheese extra bubbly.

cheesy-beef-pepper-stuffed-flatbreads.title: Cheesy Beef & Pepper Stuffed Flatbreads
cheesy-beef-pepper-stuffed-flatbreads.subtitle: Crispy outside. Cheesy inside. Really tasty!

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high. Cook ground beef until browned, breaking it up. Drain excess fat if needed.

method.title: Cook the veg
method.text: Add chopped onion and bell peppers; cook 4-5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Season the mix
method.text: Stir in tomato paste, paprika, dried herbs, salt and pepper. Cook 2-3 minutes until well combined.

method.title: Assemble flatbreads
method.text: Lay out flatbreads, pile beef mixture over one half of each, sprinkle with cheddar and fold to close.

method.title: Cook and serve
method.text: Heat a clean skillet over medium. Cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts. Slice and serve.

cheesy-beef-pepper-stuffed-flatbreads.tip: Add chili flakes for a kick or swap the beef for chicken.

cheesy-beef-taco-pasta.title: Cheesy Beef Taco Pasta
cheesy-beef-taco-pasta.subtitle: Quick cheesy weeknight pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Boil pasta in salted water according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Sauté onion
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook 2–3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Add garlic and ground beef. Cook, breaking up, until browned, about 5–6 minutes.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in taco seasoning, tomato paste, and diced tomatoes. Simmer for 5 minutes.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Stir in pasta and most of the cheese until heated. Top with remaining cheese and garnish to serve.

cheesy-beef-taco-pasta.tip: Use any short pasta. Add frozen corn or beans for extra veggies and value.

cheesy-buffalo-chicken-potato-skins.title: Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Potato Skins
cheesy-buffalo-chicken-potato-skins.subtitle: Crispy, cheesy and spicy

method.title: Bake potatoes
method.text: Scrub, prick, and bake potatoes at 400°F for 50-60 minutes until soft.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into small pieces, season with garlic powder, paprika, and mixed herbs; cook in a little oil for 6-8 minutes.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Lower heat, add hot sauce and a few tablespoons of cream cheese; stir until chicken is coated and sauce is creamy.

method.title: Prepare skins
method.text: Halve potatoes lengthwise, scoop out some flesh leaving a thin layer; mash scooped potato to mix with chicken if you like.

method.title: Fill and bake
method.text: Spoon buffalo chicken into skins, top with shredded cheddar and bake at 400°F for 10-15 minutes. Finish with scallions and extra sauce.

cheesy-buffalo-chicken-potato-skins.tip: Use leftover potato filling to make loaded cheesy mashed potatoes.

cheesy-cajun-chicken-wraps.title: Cheesy Cajun Chicken Wraps
cheesy-cajun-chicken-wraps.subtitle: Spiced chicken with melty cheddar

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Toss chicken with Cajun seasoning, salt, pepper and olive oil until evenly coated.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Pan-fry the chicken in a hot skillet 6–8 minutes until golden and cooked through; set aside.

method.title: Sauté peppers
method.text: In the same skillet, soften the onion and both peppers 3–4 minutes until slightly charred.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Mix mayonnaise with garlic powder. Fill each tortilla with lettuce, chicken, peppers and cheddar, then drizzle sauce.

method.title: Toast wraps
method.text: Fold the tortillas and toast in a dry skillet 1–2 minutes per side until golden and cheese has melted.

cheesy-cajun-chicken-wraps.tip: Cook the chicken and peppers ahead, then assemble and toast for a quick meal.

cheesy-cajun-sausage-gnocchi.title: Cheesy Cajun Sausage Gnocchi
cheesy-cajun-sausage-gnocchi.subtitle: Creamy, spicy and ready fast

method.title: Brown sausage
method.text: Slice sausages into bite-size pieces. Cook in a large skillet over medium-high until browned, then remove.

method.title: Cook vegetables
method.text: Add a little oil to the same skillet. Cook onion and bell peppers 5–6 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cajun, cook 1 minute.

method.title: Crisp gnocchi
method.text: Add gnocchi and cook 3–4 minutes, stirring, until lightly golden and slightly crispy.

method.title: Stir cream & spinach
method.text: Pour in heavy cream and simmer 2–3 minutes. Return sausages and stir in spinach until wilted.

method.title: Add cheese & serve
method.text: Stir in most of the cheddar until melted. Top with remaining cheese and a sprinkle of extra cajun to serve.

cheesy-cajun-sausage-gnocchi.tip: Add a squeeze of lemon at the end for extra flavor.

cheesy-pepperoni-pizza-wraps.title: Cheesy Pepperoni Pizza Wraps
cheesy-pepperoni-pizza-wraps.subtitle: Crispy, cheesy pizza pockets

method.title: Prepare wraps
method.text: Spread 1–2 tbsp pizza sauce over each tortilla, leaving a 1/2-inch border.

method.title: Add toppings
method.text: Scatter most of the mozzarella and cheddar, top with pepperoni, mixed herbs, garlic powder, and black pepper.

method.title: Cook wraps
method.text: Fold or roll each tortilla to enclose filling. Cook seam-side down in a dry skillet over medium heat 2–3 mins per side.

method.title: Serve hot
method.text: Cut wraps in half, scatter basil or parsley if using, and serve immediately.

cheesy-pepperoni-pizza-wraps.tip: Warm tortillas briefly before rolling to prevent tearing and help them crisp in the skillet.

cheesy-taco-quesadillas.title: Cheesy Taco Quesadillas
cheesy-taco-quesadillas.subtitle: Simple ingredients. Big flavor.

method.title: Cook veg and beef
method.text: Fry the onion and bell pepper 3-4 minutes, add beef and cook until browned.

method.title: Add seasoning
method.text: Drain excess fat, stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water, then simmer briefly.

method.title: Fill tortillas
method.text: Scatter cheese and beef mixture over half of each tortilla, fold to close.

method.title: Toast quesadillas
method.text: Cook in a dry skillet 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts. Slice and serve.

cheesy-taco-quesadillas.tip: Cook low and slow if the pan browns too fast so the cheese melts fully.

cheesy-taco-rice-skillet.title: Cheesy Taco Rice Skillet
cheesy-taco-rice-skillet.subtitle: Quick, cheap and packed with flavor!

method.title: Cook the beef
method.text: Heat a large skillet over medium. Add ground beef and cook until browned, then drain excess fat.

method.title: Cook the veg
method.text: Add chopped onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the skillet and cook 3-4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add spices & tins
method.text: Stir in taco seasoning, diced tomatoes, black beans, sweet corn and the rice. Mix to combine.

method.title: Simmer the rice
method.text: Add 2 cups water, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 15 minutes until rice is tender.

method.title: Melt and serve
method.text: Sprinkle shredded cheddar on top, cover 2 minutes to melt. Serve with cilantro or scallions.

cheesy-taco-rice-skillet.tip: Use leftover rice to cut cooking time, or swap beef for plant-based ground beef.

cheesy-tomato-pasta.title: Cheesy Tomato Pasta
cheesy-tomato-pasta.subtitle: Creamy cheesy weeknight pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package; drain, reserving a splash of cooking water.

method.title: Soften onion
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet, soften onion 3-4 minutes, then add garlic and cook 30 seconds.

method.title: Add tomatoes
method.text: Stir in crushed tomatoes and dried italian seasoning, season with salt and pepper, then simmer gently 5 minutes.

method.title: Combine and cheese
method.text: Add the cooked pasta and most of the cheddar, toss until coated and the cheese melts; add a splash of reserved water if needed.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Top with the remaining cheddar, scatter parsley if using, and serve warm.

cheesy-tomato-pasta.tip: Stir in a pinch of chili flakes or swap cheddar for mozzarella for a gooier finish.

chilli-beef-noodles.title: Chili Beef Noodles
chilli-beef-noodles.subtitle: Quick spicy beef noodle stir-fry

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Boil noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Heat a large skillet over medium. Cook ground beef until browned. Drain excess fat.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Add onion, garlic, bell pepper and stir-fry vegetables. Cook 3-4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add sauce
method.text: Stir in the chili garlic sauce and soy sauce. Simmer 2-3 minutes.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Toss in the noodles, heat through, then top with sesame seeds and scallions.

chilli-beef-noodles.tip: Use leftover or frozen veggies to save time and stretch portions.

creamy-cajun-chicken-flatbreads.title: Creamy Cajun Chicken Flatbreads
creamy-cajun-chicken-flatbreads.subtitle: Spicy, creamy and full of flavor!

method.title: Prep chicken
method.text: Slice chicken into strips and toss with the Cajun seasoning.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat a little oil in a skillet and cook the chicken 5-6 minutes until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Cook peppers & onion
method.text: Add sliced red bell pepper and onion to the skillet and cook 3-4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Lower heat, add garlic and pour in the heavy cream. Simmer 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.

method.title: Assemble and bake
method.text: Top naans with the creamy Cajun chicken, sprinkle with cheese and bake at 400°F for 5-7 minutes. Finish with parsley.

creamy-cajun-chicken-flatbreads.tip: Warm naan first for a crisper base, or swap for tortillas for a lighter meal.

creamy-garlic-chicken-gnocchi.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Gnocchi
creamy-garlic-chicken-gnocchi.subtitle: Creamy garlicky one-pan dinner

method.title: Cook gnocchi
method.text: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Cook gnocchi until they float, 2–3 minutes. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet. Season chicken and cook over medium heat until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes.

method.title: Build sauce
method.text: Add garlic to the pan and cook 30 seconds. Pour in broth, then stir in cream cheese and most parmesan until smooth.

method.title: Wilt spinach
method.text: Stir in spinach until wilted. Season with salt, pepper and chili flakes if using.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Add gnocchi and chicken to the sauce, toss to coat. Scatter remaining parmesan and parsley, then serve.

creamy-garlic-chicken-gnocchi.tip: Use leftover rotisserie chicken to save time, or swap cream cheese for low-fat spreadable cheese for a lighter sauce.

creamy-garlic-chicken-orzo.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Orzo
creamy-garlic-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Creamy garlicky orzo

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet. Cook diced chicken until golden and cooked through, then transfer to a plate.

method.title: Saute onion & garlic
method.text: In the same skillet, soften the onion 2–3 minutes, then add garlic and cook about 30 seconds.

method.title: Simmer the orzo
method.text: Add the orzo and chicken broth. Simmer 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until the orzo is tender.

method.title: Stir in cheese
method.text: Stir in the cream cheese, parmesan, and Italian seasoning, then return the cooked chicken and mix until creamy.

method.title: Add spinach & serve
method.text: Fold in the spinach until wilted. Season with salt and black pepper, then serve warm.

creamy-garlic-chicken-orzo.tip: Add a squeeze of lemon or a pinch of chili flakes to brighten the dish.

creamy-garlic-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Pasta
creamy-garlic-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Rich, creamy and ready quickly

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the penne to package directions, drain and set aside.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt, pepper and Italian seasoning. Fry in oil until golden.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Add more oil if needed and sauté the onion and garlic 2 minutes. Stir in sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Add cream & spinach
method.text: Pour in the heavy cream, simmer 3-4 minutes. Add a handful of spinach and stir until wilted. Season to taste.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Add cooked pasta and most of the shredded cheese, toss until creamy. Top with remaining cheese, pepper and herbs.

creamy-garlic-chicken-pasta.tip: Swap the chicken for shrimp or use broccoli instead of spinach for a different twist!

creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.title: Creamy Garlic Chicken Rice
creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.subtitle: Creamy chicken in a garlicky sauce

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Cook rice according to package directions and keep warm.

method.title: Season and fry
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and half the italian seasoning. Sear in a little oil 5–6 minutes per side; slice.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: In the same pan cook the onion 3–4 minutes. Add garlic and red pepper flakes 1 minute. Pour in cream, add remaining seasoning and a handful of parmesan; simmer 2–3 minutes.

method.title: Add the greens
method.text: Stir in spinach until wilted, return the sliced chicken to the pan and coat in the sauce.

method.title: Serve and enjoy
method.text: Serve the chicken and sauce over the rice. Top with extra parmesan and cracked pepper.

creamy-garlic-chicken-rice.tip: Add mushrooms for extra flavor or swap the spinach for broccoli.

creamy-garlic-sausage-pasta.title: Creamy Garlic Sausage Pasta
creamy-garlic-sausage-pasta.subtitle: Quick creamy sausage pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Boil a large pot of salted water and cook the pasta to package directions. Reserve a splash of pasta water.

method.title: Brown sausage
method.text: Remove sausage meat from casings and brown in a large skillet with a drizzle of oil. Add chopped onion and cook 4-5 minutes, then add garlic 1 minute.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Stir in the cream cheese and a splash of pasta water or a dissolved bouillon cube. Stir until it melts into a creamy sauce.

method.title: Add spinach & pasta
method.text: Add the spinach and cooked pasta to the skillet. Toss until the spinach wilts and everything is well coated in the sauce.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Stir in the shredded cheese, season with salt and pepper, give everything a final toss and serve immediately.

creamy-garlic-sausage-pasta.tip: Add chili flakes for an extra kick.

creamy-harissa-chicken-couscous.title: Creamy Harissa Chicken Couscous
creamy-harissa-chicken-couscous.subtitle: Spicy, creamy and full of flavor

method.title: Season and fry
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and 1 tbsp harissa. Fry in a little oil 6–8 minutes until cooked, then slice.

method.title: Cook vegetables
method.text: In the same skillet, cook chopped onion and red pepper 5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Stir in remaining harissa and creme fraiche. Simmer 2–3 minutes, add spinach and sliced chicken and warm through.

method.title: Cook couscous
method.text: Prepare couscous according to package directions, then fluff with a fork.

method.title: To serve
method.text: Spoon couscous into bowls, top with creamy harissa chicken, squeeze lemon over and scatter chopped parsley.

creamy-harissa-chicken-couscous.tip: Add crumbled feta or a drizzle of chili oil before serving.

creamy-lemon-chicken-orzo.title: Creamy Lemon Chicken Orzo
creamy-lemon-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Easy • Creamy • Bright and comforting

method.title: season and sear
method.text: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and mixed herbs. Sear in olive oil until golden and cooked through, then set aside.

method.title: soften aromatics
method.text: In the same skillet, cook the onion and garlic until softened. Stir in the orzo and cook for 1 minute.

method.title: add liquids
method.text: Pour in the chicken broth, half-and-half, lemon zest and juice. Bring to a gentle simmer.

method.title: simmer orzo
method.text: Simmer until the orzo is tender and the sauce has thickened, stirring occasionally.

method.title: finish and serve
method.text: Stir in spinach and parmesan, return the chicken to the skillet, season to taste and serve with extra parmesan.

creamy-lemon-chicken-orzo.tip: Use leftover rotisserie chicken to cut prep time, or add extra lemon for a brighter finish.

creamy-peri-peri-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Peri-Peri Chicken Pasta
creamy-peri-peri-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Spicy, creamy and full of flavor

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Season and fry
method.text: Cut chicken into strips, season with salt, pepper and Italian seasoning. Fry in a hot skillet until cooked through.

method.title: Add the veggies
method.text: Add onion, red bell pepper and garlic to the skillet. Cook 2-3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in peri-peri sauce, then pour in the heavy cream. Simmer 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Add pasta, spinach and half the cheddar. Stir to combine, top with remaining cheese and serve.

creamy-peri-peri-chicken-pasta.tip: Add extra peri-peri to increase heat, and a squeeze of lemon to brighten the flavor.

creamy-pesto-chicken-gnocchi.title: Creamy Pesto Chicken Gnocchi
creamy-pesto-chicken-gnocchi.subtitle: Creamy, herby comfort dinner

method.title: Prep chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, pepper and Italian seasoning.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat a large skillet with a little oil. Sear chicken 5-6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then remove.

method.title: Fry gnocchi
method.text: Add a little more oil to the skillet and fry the gnocchi 4-5 minutes until golden and slightly crispy.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Add minced garlic and tomatoes; cook 2-3 minutes. Lower heat, stir in pesto and heavy cream and simmer 2 minutes.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Return chicken to the skillet, stir in spinach until wilted. Top with grated cheese and a pinch of black pepper.

creamy-pesto-chicken-gnocchi.tip: Squeeze a little lemon over at the end to make the flavors pop.

creamy-sun-dried-tomato-chicken-orzo.title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Chicken Orzo
creamy-sun-dried-tomato-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Creamy orzo with sun-dried tomatoes

method.title: Season & fry chicken
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and Italian seasoning. Heat oil in a large skillet; cook 4-5 minutes until cooked through. Remove.

method.title: Sauté garlic & tomatoes
method.text: In the same skillet, sauté garlic 30 seconds, then add sun-dried tomatoes and cook 1-2 minutes.

method.title: Cook the orzo
method.text: Add orzo and chicken broth. Simmer 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is almost tender.

method.title: Stir in cheese & spinach
method.text: Stir in cream cheese, Parmesan, spinach and sliced chicken. Simmer 2-3 minutes until creamy and spinach wilts.

method.title: Serve & enjoy
method.text: Season to taste and serve topped with extra Parmesan or fresh herbs if you like.

creamy-sun-dried-tomato-chicken-orzo.tip: Use leftover rotisserie chicken to save time; finish with extra Parmesan or fresh basil.

creamy-tomato-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Tomato Chicken Pasta
creamy-tomato-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Creamy, tangy chicken pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Cook the penne in salted boiling water until al dente, following the package directions.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces; season with salt, pepper and italian seasoning, then cook in oil in a skillet until done.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Add garlic to the skillet and cook 1 minute. Add cherry tomatoes, soften, then stir in tomato paste and cream; simmer 5–7 minutes.

method.title: Combine and simmer
method.text: Add the cooked pasta and chicken to the sauce, toss to coat and simmer 2 minutes.

method.title: Serve and enjoy
method.text: Divide among bowls and top with parmesan and extra herbs to serve.

creamy-tomato-chicken-pasta.tip: Stir in spinach or swap cream for crème fraîche for a tangier sauce and more veggies.

creamy-tomato-pasta.title: Creamy Tomato Pasta
creamy-tomato-pasta.subtitle: Rich, creamy, garlicky and quick

method.title: cook pasta
method.text: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving a splash of pasta water, and set aside.

method.title: sauté onion
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion 3–4 minutes until soft.

method.title: add garlic & paste
method.text: Stir in garlic and cook 1 minute. Add tomato paste and cook 1–2 minutes to deepen flavor.

method.title: simmer sauce
method.text: Add canned tomatoes, herbs, red pepper flakes and seasoning. Simmer 8–10 minutes until slightly reduced.

method.title: finish and serve
method.text: Stir in cream and simmer 2–3 minutes. Toss in pasta, coat with sauce and top with cheese and basil.

creamy-tomato-pasta.tip: Add a splash of pasta water or a pat of butter for extra richness.

creamy-tomato-potato-bake.title: Creamy Tomato Potato Bake
creamy-tomato-potato-bake.subtitle: Comforting creamy tomato casserole

method.title: Preheat oven
method.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease a medium baking dish.

method.title: Prep potatoes
method.text: Thinly slice potatoes about 1/8 in. Toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper; microwave 5 minutes or parboil.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Sauté chopped onion and crushed garlic in a little oil 3–4 minutes. Stir in diced tomatoes, cream and oregano; simmer 3 minutes.

method.title: Assemble bake
method.text: Spread a third of sauce in dish, layer half the potatoes, repeat and finish with grated cheddar.

method.title: Bake and serve
method.text: Bake 10 minutes at 400°F until bubbling and cheese is melted. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

creamy-tomato-potato-bake.tip: Parboil or microwave the slices first for even layers and a quicker bake.

creamy-tuscan-chicken-pasta.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Pasta
creamy-tuscan-chicken-pasta.subtitle: Creamy tomato and spinach pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne according to package directions. Drain, reserve some pasta water.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet, season the chicken and cook until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Stir in garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, add broth and cream cheese, simmer until smooth and slightly reduced.

method.title: Add greens
method.text: Add spinach and Parmesan, cook until wilted, then toss in drained pasta, using reserved pasta water to loosen if needed.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Divide between plates, season to taste and finish with basil or parsley and extra Parmesan if desired.

creamy-tuscan-chicken-pasta.tip: Reserve a splash of pasta water to loosen the sauce if it gets too thick.

crispy-bean-quesadillas.title: Crispy Bean Quesadillas
crispy-bean-quesadillas.subtitle: Golden crispy, loaded with melted cheese

method.title: Prep veggies
method.text: Finely chop the onion and red bell pepper, and crush or finely chop the garlic.

method.title: Cook filling
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion and bell pepper 5 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add beans
method.text: Stir in garlic and spices; cook 1 minute. Add beans and tomatoes, simmer 8–10 minutes and season.

method.title: Assemble quesadillas
method.text: Spread a spoonful of the bean mix and sprinkle cheese on one tortilla. Top with another tortilla.

method.title: Cook & serve
method.text: Cook 2–3 minutes per side in a skillet until golden and cheese melts. Slice into wedges and serve.

crispy-bean-quesadillas.tip: For extra crisp, add a bit more oil and press the quesadilla with a spatula while cooking.

crispy-beef-burrito-bowls.title: Crispy Beef Burrito Bowls
crispy-beef-burrito-bowls.subtitle: Bold flavors. Fresh ingredients.

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook rice according to package directions.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet and cook ground beef until browned.

method.title: Add seasoning
method.text: Stir in taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer 2-3 minutes.

method.title: Prep veggies
method.text: Warm the beans and corn. Chop tomatoes, onion and lettuce; mash the avocado.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice among bowls. Top with beef, beans, veggies, sour cream and a squeeze of lime.

crispy-beef-burrito-bowls.tip: Add jalapeños or hot sauce for more heat, or swap sour cream for Greek yogurt to lighten it.

crispy-beef-taco-rice-bowls.title: Crispy Beef Taco Rice Bowls
crispy-beef-taco-rice-bowls.subtitle: Easy takeout-style dinner at home.

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to the package instructions; keep warm.

method.title: Cook veg
method.text: Sauté the chopped onion and bell pepper in a little oil until softened.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned all over.

method.title: Add seasonings
method.text: Stir in smoked paprika, cumin, tomato paste and corn; cook until thick and slightly sticky.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice among bowls, add romaine and tomatoes, top with beef, cheddar and sour cream.

crispy-beef-taco-rice-bowls.tip: For extra crunch, leave the beef undisturbed for a minute so it caramelizes.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-bowls.title: Crispy Sweet Chili Chicken Bowls
crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-bowls.subtitle: Sticky, crispy & fresh

method.title: Coat chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Toss with cornstarch or breadcrumbs, garlic powder, salt and pepper.

method.title: Fry chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet and fry the chicken 6-8 minutes until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Stir-fry peppers
method.text: In the same skillet, stir-fry the bell peppers 3-4 minutes until just tender.

method.title: Add sauce
method.text: Return chicken to the skillet, stir in the sweet chili sauce and cook 1-2 minutes until sticky.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice between bowls. Top with chicken, peppers, cucumber and scallions. Drizzle mayo and serve.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-bowls.tip: Use cornstarch for extra crunch or breadcrumbs for a lighter coating.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.title: Crispy Sweet Chili Chicken Noodles
crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.subtitle: Sticky, speedy stir-fry

method.title: Prep everything
method.text: Thinly slice chicken and cut vegetables into thin strips. Have noodles and sauces ready.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet or wok. Add chicken; cook until golden and cooked through, 4–5 minutes.

method.title: Stir-fry vegetables
method.text: Add carrot, bell pepper, and sugar snap peas. Stir-fry 2–3 minutes until crisp-tender.

method.title: Add noodles
method.text: Toss in noodles, scallions, garlic paste, soy sauce and sweet chili sauce. Stir until coated and hot.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Scatter sesame seeds (and cilantro or chili flakes if using). Serve straight from the pan.

crispy-sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.tip: Use a hot pan and don't overcrowd so the chicken crisps up; add cilantro for freshness.

crispy-sweet-chilli-halloumi-burgers.title: Crispy Sweet Chili Halloumi Burgers
crispy-sweet-chilli-halloumi-burgers.subtitle: Crispy halloumi with sweet chili mayo

method.title: Prepare halloumi
method.text: Slice the halloumi into thick pieces. Coat each slice in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.

method.title: Heat the oil
method.text: Warm a little oil in a skillet over medium heat.

method.title: Fry until golden
method.text: Fry the coated halloumi until golden and crispy, about 2–3 minutes per side.

method.title: Build the burgers
method.text: Mix mayo with a little sweet chili. Toast buns, then layer lettuce, red onion, and crispy halloumi.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Drizzle extra sweet chili sauce over the halloumi and serve immediately.

crispy-sweet-chilli-halloumi-burgers.tip: Press slices into the breadcrumbs twice for an extra-crispy coating.

garlic-butter-chicken-and-rice.title: Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice
garlic-butter-chicken-and-rice.subtitle: Creamy, garlicky comfort food

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook rice according to package directions.

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Season chicken with salt, pepper and mixed herbs.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Melt half the butter in a large skillet. Cook chicken 5-6 minutes until golden and cooked; remove.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Add remaining butter, cook onion 2-3 minutes. Add garlic and red pepper flakes 1 minute. Stir in cream and crumbled bouillon; simmer 2-3 minutes.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Stir in spinach and cheese, return chicken and coat in sauce. Serve over rice.

garlic-butter-chicken-and-rice.tip: Add extra veggies like broccoli or peas to bulk it up and make it more filling.

garlic-butter-chicken-flatbreads.title: Garlic-Butter Chicken Flatbreads
garlic-butter-chicken-flatbreads.subtitle: Buttery garlic chicken wraps

method.title: Prepare chicken
method.text: Slice chicken into strips; season with salt and pepper.

method.title: Make garlic butter
method.text: Melt butter with olive oil, stir in crushed garlic and lemon juice.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Sear chicken in a hot skillet until cooked through and golden, about 5-7 minutes.

method.title: Warm flatbreads
method.text: Warm flatbreads in a dry pan or in the oven until soft and slightly charred.

method.title: Assemble wraps
method.text: Spread garlic butter on flatbreads, add chicken, spring mix and parsley, squeeze over lemon.

garlic-butter-chicken-flatbreads.tip: Wrap flatbreads in foil and warm in a low oven to keep them soft and flexible.

garlic-butter-flatbreads.title: Garlic Butter Flatbreads
garlic-butter-flatbreads.subtitle: Golden garlicky flatbreads

method.title: Make garlic butter
method.text: Melt the butter, then stir in minced garlic, chopped parsley, dried herbs, salt and pepper.

method.title: Prepare flatbreads
method.text: Place the naans on a baking sheet and brush or spoon the garlic butter evenly over each one.

method.title: Add cheese
method.text: Sprinkle with grated hard cheese and a little extra dried herbs if you like.

method.title: Bake until golden
method.text: Bake at 400°F for 6-8 minutes, or until the edges are golden and crisp.

method.title: Slice and serve
method.text: Slice and serve hot as a side, snack or alongside your favorite meal.

garlic-butter-flatbreads.tip: For crisp edges, broil for 1 minute at the end; wrap to keep soft if serving later.

garlic-butter-halloumi-couscous.title: Garlic Butter Halloumi Couscous
garlic-butter-halloumi-couscous.subtitle: Zesty garlic halloumi couscous

method.title: Prepare couscous
method.text: Pour 3/4 cup boiling water over the couscous, cover and leave 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

method.title: Fry halloumi
method.text: Cut halloumi into cubes. Fry in a little olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat 2-3 minutes per side until golden.

method.title: Make garlic butter
method.text: Lower the heat, add the butter and minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

method.title: Combine and serve
method.text: Toss couscous with garlic butter, halloumi, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, lemon juice and parsley. Season and serve.

garlic-butter-halloumi-couscous.tip: Swap parsley for mint or add chili flakes for extra freshness and heat.

garlic-butter-sausage-pasta.title: Garlic Butter Sausage Pasta
garlic-butter-sausage-pasta.subtitle: Creamy garlic butter pasta

method.title: Cook pasta
method.text: Cook pasta in boiling salted water following package directions. Reserve a little pasta water.

method.title: Fry sausages
method.text: Fry sausages in olive oil over medium heat until browned and cooked through. Remove and keep warm.

method.title: Sauté onion & garlic
method.text: In the same skillet, soften the onion 3–4 minutes; add garlic and butter and cook until fragrant.

method.title: Combine & toss
method.text: Return sausages to the skillet, add drained pasta, a splash of pasta water and parmesan; toss to coat.

method.title: Season & serve
method.text: Season with salt, black pepper and chili flakes if using. Finish with chopped parsley and serve.

garlic-butter-sausage-pasta.tip: Reserve a little pasta water to make the sauce glossy and help the cheese cling to the pasta.

garlic-butter-sausage-veggie-skillet.title: Garlic Butter Sausage & Veggie Skillet
garlic-butter-sausage-veggie-skillet.subtitle: Simple, hearty, so satisfying

method.title: Par-cook potatoes
method.text: Par-cook the potatoes until just tender, then drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown the sausage
method.text: Slice the sausage and brown in a large skillet with the oil until golden.

method.title: Add veg and butter
method.text: Add potatoes, bell peppers, onion, garlic, butter and Italian seasoning to the skillet.

method.title: Crisp and cook
method.text: Cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are golden and the vegetables are tender.

method.title: Season and serve
method.text: Season with salt and black pepper to taste and serve hot.

garlic-butter-sausage-veggie-skillet.tip: Partially cook potatoes in the microwave to save time, then crisp them in the skillet.

garlic-parmesan-chicken-flatbreads.title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Flatbreads
garlic-parmesan-chicken-flatbreads.subtitle: Cheesy, garlicky takeout-style

method.title: Season chicken
method.text: Mix chicken with garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Assemble flatbreads
method.text: Spread garlic and herb cream cheese over flatbreads, then top with mozzarella, chicken and parmesan.

method.title: Bake or air-fry
method.text: Bake or air-fry at 400°F until flatbreads are crisp and the cheese is melted and bubbly.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Scatter chopped parsley over the flatbreads, slice and serve hot.

garlic-parmesan-chicken-flatbreads.tip: Drizzle garlic mayo over the flatbreads after cooking for extra takeout flavor.

garlic-sausage-rice-bowls.title: Garlic Sausage Rice Bowls
garlic-sausage-rice-bowls.subtitle: Juicy sausages, garlicky rice & veggies

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook rice according to package directions; keep covered and warm.

method.title: Cook sausages
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook sausages 10-12 minutes, turning, until cooked through. Remove and slice.

method.title: Cook veg
method.text: In the same skillet, cook onion and bell pepper 5-6 minutes until soft. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Combine & simmer
method.text: Return sausages to skillet. Add peas, Italian seasoning and red pepper flakes. Stir in sour cream and simmer 2-3 minutes. Season.

method.title: Serve
method.text: Divide rice among bowls, spoon sausage mixture over rice and top with cheddar and extra herbs.

garlic-sausage-rice-bowls.tip: Add a squeeze of lemon or extra herbs for more flavor!

honey-chilli-chicken-noodles.title: Honey Chili Chicken Noodles
honey-chilli-chicken-noodles.subtitle: Quick takeout-style noodles at home.

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Cook noodles to package instructions, drain and reserve a little cooking water.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet or wok and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Add veggies & garlic
method.text: Add red bell pepper, scallions and garlic, cook 2-3 minutes until just softened.

method.title: Add sauces
method.text: Stir in sweet chili sauce, honey, soy and red pepper flakes, then add noodles and toss well.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Mix until glossy and hot, loosen with reserved noodle water if needed, then scatter sesame seeds.

honey-chilli-chicken-noodles.tip: Add a splash of reserved noodle water to loosen the sauce so it coats every strand.

honey-soy-beef-noodles.title: Honey Soy Beef Noodles
honey-soy-beef-noodles.subtitle: Sweet, savory and speedy

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook egg noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high. Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up. Drain if needed.

method.title: Add veggies
method.text: Add sliced onion and bell pepper; cook 3-4 minutes until softened. Stir in minced garlic and cook 1 minute more.

method.title: Mix the sauce
method.text: Whisk soy sauce, honey and sesame oil in a small bowl. Pour into pan and simmer 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.

method.title: Toss and serve
method.text: Add cooked noodles and toss until well coated. Top with sliced scallions and sesame seeds, then serve.

honey-soy-beef-noodles.tip: Swap beef for shredded chicken or tofu to save money and vary the dish.

honey-soy-sausage-noodle-bowls.title: Honey Soy Sausage Noodle Bowls
honey-soy-sausage-noodle-bowls.subtitle: Sticky honey-soy noodle bowls

method.title: cook sausages
method.text: Cook sausages in a skillet or oven until browned and cooked through, then slice.

method.title: cook noodles
method.text: Cook the noodles according to package directions, then drain.

method.title: fry pepper
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet, fry the red bell pepper 2–3 minutes, then add sliced sausages.

method.title: add sauces
method.text: Stir in soy sauce, honey, sweet chili sauce and garlic paste until everything is sticky and coated.

method.title: combine and serve
method.text: Toss in the noodles and scallions, divide between bowls and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

honey-soy-sausage-noodle-bowls.tip: Bulk it out with shredded cabbage or extra veggies to stretch portions and add crunch.

hot-honey-chicken-flatbread-pizzas.title: Hot Honey Chicken Flatbread Pizzas
hot-honey-chicken-flatbread-pizzas.subtitle: Sweet heat. Juicy chicken. Seriously good.

method.title: Prep chicken
method.text: If raw, sauté in oil with minced garlic, smoked paprika, salt and pepper until cooked; shred. If cooked, toss with hot honey, garlic and paprika.

method.title: Prep toppings
method.text: Thinly slice red onion and jalapeños, grate the mozzarella and chop the cilantro.

method.title: Assemble flatbreads
method.text: Lay flatbreads on a baking tray. Top with the honey chicken, mozzarella, red onion and jalapeños.

method.title: Bake flatbreads
method.text: Bake in a hot oven 400°F for 8–10 minutes until cheese melts and starts to brown.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Drizzle with extra hot honey, scatter cilantro and a pinch of chili flakes if you like. Slice and serve hot.

hot-honey-chicken-flatbread-pizzas.tip: Use leftover roast chicken to make this even quicker — perfect for turning leftovers into something epic!

loaded-bbq-beef-nachos.title: Loaded BBQ Beef Nachos
loaded-bbq-beef-nachos.subtitle: Smoky, cheesy BBQ nachos

method.title: Cook the beef
method.text: Heat a skillet and brown the ground beef with smoked paprika, seasoning with salt and pepper.

method.title: Add the sauce
method.text: Stir in the BBQ sauce and simmer 1–2 minutes until the beef is glossy and coated.

method.title: Layer the chips
method.text: Spread tortilla chips on a baking sheet and top with the beef, diced red onion and sliced jalapeño.

method.title: Melt the cheese
method.text: Sprinkle shredded cheese over chips and place under the broiler or in a 400°F oven 3–5 minutes.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Top with sour cream, sliced scallion and cilantro if using. Serve immediately so chips stay crisp.

loaded-bbq-beef-nachos.tip: Use pickled jalapeños for extra tang and serve straight from the oven so the chips stay crisp.

loaded-taco-jacket-potato.title: Loaded Taco Baked Potato
loaded-taco-jacket-potato.subtitle: Crispy baked potato, zesty taco filling

method.title: Bake potatoes
method.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Scrub, prick and rub potatoes with oil and salt. Bake 50–60 minutes until crisp and fluffy.

method.title: Sauté onion & garlic
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook onion 3–4 minutes until soft, add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Add ground beef, break up with a spoon and cook until browned. Drain excess fat if needed.

method.title: Season & simmer
method.text: Stir in taco seasoning and 1/3 cup water. Simmer 5–10 minutes until thick and well flavored.

method.title: Assemble & serve
method.text: Cut potatoes open, fluff the insides and spoon over beef. Top with cheese, lettuce, tomato and sour cream.

loaded-taco-jacket-potato.tip: Swap beef for black beans or lentils for a vegetarian option; add crushed tortilla chips for crunch.

one-pan-smoky-beef-orzo.title: One-Pan Smoky Beef Orzo
one-pan-smoky-beef-orzo.subtitle: Big flavor, minimal effort

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat a large deep skillet over medium-high. Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up. Drain fat if needed.

method.title: Cook the veg
method.text: Add red onion and bell pepper and cook 3-4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Add spices & orzo
method.text: Stir in smoked paprika, then add orzo, canned tomatoes and 2 cups water (or beef stock made with bouillon). Season.

method.title: Simmer gently
method.text: Bring to a gentle boil, reduce to medium and simmer 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until orzo is tender and sauce thickens.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Stir in spinach until wilted, top with cheddar and cover a couple minutes to melt. Serve straight from the skillet.

one-pan-smoky-beef-orzo.tip: Add a pinch of chili flakes for extra kick or swap the spinach for kale!

one-pan-tomato-chicken-orzo.title: One-Pan Tomato Chicken Orzo
one-pan-tomato-chicken-orzo.subtitle: Creamy tomato chicken orzo

method.title: Brown chicken
method.text: Heat a large deep skillet with oil. Season chicken; cook until golden on both sides. Remove and set aside.

method.title: Sauté onion
method.text: Add chopped onion and cook 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Add orzo
method.text: Return chicken to the pan. Stir in orzo, diced tomatoes, chicken broth and Italian seasoning. Season to taste.

method.title: Simmer gently
method.text: Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is tender.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.text: Stir in cream cheese and spinach until wilted and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve immediately.

one-pan-tomato-chicken-orzo.tip: Finish with grated cheese or fresh basil for extra flavor.

sticky-bbq-beef-rice-bowls.title: Sticky BBQ Beef Rice Bowls
sticky-bbq-beef-rice-bowls.subtitle: Quick sticky beef and rice

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Cook rice to package instructions, or heat microwave pouches, then keep warm.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet and cook ground beef until browned.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Stir in sliced red bell pepper and garlic; cook 2-3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Make it sticky
method.text: Add BBQ sauce, soy sauce, honey, and smoked paprika. Simmer 2 minutes until glossy.

method.title: To serve
method.text: Spoon beef over rice and top with sliced scallions and sesame seeds.

sticky-bbq-beef-rice-bowls.tip: Use microwave rice pouches to save time, or add chili flakes for a spicy kick.

sticky-bbq-chicken-rice-bowls.title: Sticky BBQ Chicken Rice Bowls
sticky-bbq-chicken-rice-bowls.subtitle: Sticky BBQ chicken with fluffy rice

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Cook rice in boiling salted water according to package directions. Drain and keep warm.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook in a large skillet with a little oil until cooked through, 8–10 mins.

method.title: Add the veggies
method.text: Add chopped onion, bell pepper, and crushed garlic to the skillet; cook 4–5 mins until softened.

method.title: Make it sticky
method.text: Stir in BBQ sauce, soy sauce, and honey. Simmer 3–5 mins until sauce thickens and coats the chicken.

method.title: Serve and garnish
method.text: Spoon chicken and sauce over rice and finish with sliced scallions.

sticky-bbq-chicken-rice-bowls.tip: Add chili flakes for extra heat.

sticky-beef-noodles.title: Sticky Beef Noodles
sticky-beef-noodles.subtitle: Sweet sticky stir-fry

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.

method.title: Brown beef
method.text: Heat oil in a hot skillet and cook beef strips until browned.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Add garlic and red bell pepper; cook 2–3 minutes until just softened.

method.title: Toss with sauce
method.text: Stir in soy sauce, hoisin, sweet chili sauce and honey, then add noodles and toss until glossy.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Scatter scallions and sesame seeds, season to taste and serve.

sticky-beef-noodles.tip: Stir in frozen peas or shredded cabbage with the peppers for extra veg and color.

sticky-beef-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Beef Rice Bowls
sticky-beef-rice-bowls.subtitle: Simple ingredients. Huge flavor.

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook rice according to package directions.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat a large skillet and cook ground beef until browned. Drain any excess fat.

method.title: Add veg and garlic
method.text: Add diced bell pepper, stir-fry vegetables, and crushed garlic. Cook 3-5 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add sauce and serve
method.text: Stir in soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil. Simmer 2-3 minutes. Serve over rice and top with scallions.

sticky-beef-rice-bowls.tip: Make extra sauce and toss through rice for saucier bowls.

sticky-chicken-loaded-fries.title: Sticky Chicken Loaded Fries
sticky-chicken-loaded-fries.subtitle: Sweet, sticky, crispy and unreal!

method.title: Cook fries
method.text: Preheat oven to package temp (about 425°F). Bake fries per package until crispy.

method.title: Prep chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat a little oil in a skillet and cook chicken over medium-high until golden and cooked through.

method.title: Add veg and sauce
method.text: Add garlic and red bell pepper; cook 2-3 minutes. Stir in soy, sweet chili, honey and ketchup, simmer until sticky.

method.title: Assemble and finish
method.text: Pile fries on plates, top with sticky chicken, scatter scallions and sesame seeds to finish.

sticky-chicken-loaded-fries.tip: Drizzle sriracha or mayo on top for extra flavor.

sticky-garlic-beef-loaded-fries.title: Sticky Garlic Beef Loaded Fries
sticky-garlic-beef-loaded-fries.subtitle: Cheesy sticky garlic beef fries

method.title: Cook fries
method.text: Bake or air-fry frozen fries until golden and crispy, following package directions.

method.title: Cook beef
method.text: Heat a skillet and cook beef strips until browned. Add garlic and stir for 30-60 seconds.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Stir in soy sauce, honey, sweet chili sauce and sesame oil. Cook until the beef is sticky and coated.

method.title: Assemble and serve
method.text: Pile fries on a plate, scatter cheese, spoon sticky beef on top and finish with scallions and sesame seeds.

sticky-garlic-beef-loaded-fries.tip: Use pre-shredded cheese and oven-bake the fries for extra crispiness.

sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.title: Sticky Hoisin Beef Flatbreads
sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.subtitle: Quick, easy and full of flavor!

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Cook the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high until browned. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Stir in hoisin, soy sauce and a splash of water. Simmer 5-7 minutes until the sauce is thick and glossy.

method.title: Prep the veg
method.text: Thinly slice the red onion and cucumber, grate the carrots and chop the cilantro.

method.title: Warm the breads
method.text: Heat flatbreads in a dry skillet or in a 350°F oven a few minutes until warm and slightly crisp.

method.title: Assemble flatbreads
method.text: Top each flatbread with sticky beef, fresh veg, cilantro and sesame seeds. Add extra hoisin or mayo if liked.

sticky-hoisin-beef-flatbreads.tip: Swap the beef for chicken or meatless ground crumbles for a cheaper option that's just as tasty!

sticky-honey-garlic-chicken-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken Rice Bowls
sticky-honey-garlic-chicken-rice-bowls.subtitle: Quick sticky chicken bowls

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Rinse rice and cook according to package directions. Keep warm.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Whisk honey, soy sauce, and ketchup in a small bowl. Set aside.

method.title: Fry the chicken
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 6–8 minutes until browned.

method.title: Add garlic and sauce
method.text: Stir in garlic for 1 minute, then add the sauce. Simmer 2–3 minutes until sticky and glossy.

method.title: Serve and finish
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, top with sticky chicken and finish with scallions and sesame seeds.

sticky-honey-garlic-chicken-rice-bowls.tip: Use chicken thighs for extra juiciness and flavor — they're often cheaper and stay tender!

sticky-honey-garlic-sausage-rice.title: Sticky Honey Garlic Sausage Bowls
sticky-honey-garlic-sausage-rice.subtitle: sweet, sticky and dinner-ready

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Heat the microwave jasmine rice according to package instructions.

method.title: Brown sausages
method.text: Slice sausages and fry in a little olive oil over medium-high until golden and caramelized. Remove.

method.title: Stir-fry veggies
method.text: In the same skillet, stir-fry broccoli and red pepper 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.

method.title: Make sauce
method.text: Whisk together honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic in a small bowl.

method.title: Combine and Serve
method.text: Return sausages to the skillet, pour in the sauce and simmer 2-3 minutes. Serve over rice with scallions and sesame seeds.

sticky-honey-garlic-sausage-rice.tip: Add chili flakes for heat or swap honey for maple syrup to change the flavor.

sticky-korean-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.title: Sticky Korean BBQ Chicken Loaded Fries
sticky-korean-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.subtitle: Takeout vibes for a fraction of the price

method.title: Cook the fries
method.text: Cook the fries according to package directions until golden and crispy.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.text: Mix gochujang paste, soy sauce, honey, garlic powder, and ground ginger in a bowl.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.text: Fry diced chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through, about 6–8 minutes.

method.title: Simmer in sauce
method.text: Pour sauce over chicken and simmer 3–4 minutes until sticky and coated.

method.title: Assemble & finish
method.text: Pile fries on plates, top with sticky chicken and scatter scallions, sesame seeds, and mayo.

sticky-korean-bbq-chicken-loaded-fries.tip: Add a pinch of chili flakes for extra heat or swap chicken for crispy tofu.

sticky-korean-beef-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Korean Beef Rice Bowls
sticky-korean-beef-rice-bowls.subtitle: sticky, sweet Korean-style beef

method.title: Prepare rice & veg
method.text: Microwave the rice pouch per package. Slice the cucumber, peel the carrot into ribbons and slice scallions.

method.title: Brown the beef
method.text: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.

method.title: Add the sauce
method.text: Stir in soy sauce, sweet chili, honey, garlic and ginger. Simmer a few minutes until the mix is glossy and sticky.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, top with beef and veg. Scatter sesame seeds and scallions. Add red pepper flakes if desired.

sticky-korean-beef-rice-bowls.tip: Use leftover rice for quick lunches. Add red pepper flakes to taste for extra heat.

sticky-maple-sausage-traybake.title: Sticky Maple Sausage Sheet Pan
sticky-maple-sausage-traybake.subtitle: Sweet, savory and packed with flavor

method.title: Prep the veggies
method.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Chop potatoes, red bell pepper, and red onion into chunks and spread on a large sheet pan.

method.title: Make the glaze
method.text: Stir together maple syrup, soy sauce, minced garlic, dried herbs, a drizzle of olive oil, and seasoning in a small bowl.

method.title: Add everything
method.text: Nestle the sausages among the veggies, pour the glaze over, and toss so everything is well coated.

method.title: Roast in oven
method.text: Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until sausages are browned and the veggies are tender and caramelized.

method.title: Serve and enjoy
method.text: Spoon onto plates, drizzle with any extra glaze, and sprinkle with fresh herbs if you have them.

sticky-maple-sausage-traybake.tip: Add a pinch of chili flakes or swap potatoes for sweet potatoes for extra flavor.

sticky-teriyaki-sausage-rice-bowls.title: Sticky Teriyaki Sausage Rice Bowls
sticky-teriyaki-sausage-rice-bowls.subtitle: Sweet sticky sausages over rice

method.title: Cook rice
method.text: Cook the rice according to package instructions.

method.title: Brown sausages
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet. Cook sausages until browned and cooked through.

method.title: Add veg
method.text: Add bell peppers and garlic; cook 3-4 minutes until softened.

method.title: Glaze sausages
method.text: Stir in teriyaki and soy sauce, add a splash of water if needed and simmer to glaze.

method.title: Finish & serve
method.text: Serve sticky sausages over rice. Scatter scallions and sesame seeds to finish.

sticky-teriyaki-sausage-rice-bowls.tip: Use a microwave rice pouch to get this on the table even faster.

sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.title: Sweet Chili Beef Noodles
sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.subtitle: Quick sticky chili noodles

method.title: Prep veg & noodles
method.text: Slice bell pepper, grate carrot, chop scallions and crush garlic. Cover noodles with boiling water to soften.

method.title: Brown ground beef
method.text: Heat oil in a large skillet, add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up, about 4-5 minutes.

method.title: Stir in veg
method.text: Add bell pepper, carrot and garlic to the skillet and stir-fry 2-3 minutes until softened.

method.title: Add sauces
method.text: Pour in sweet chili and soy sauce, stir well and simmer 1-2 minutes so flavors combine.

method.title: Combine & Serve
method.text: Drain noodles, add to skillet with scallions and toss to coat. Divide between bowls and serve hot.

sweet-chilli-beef-noodles.tip: Stretch the meal with frozen peas or extra veg, and use scallion whites when cooking for extra flavor.

sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.title: Sweet Chili Chicken Noodles
sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.subtitle: Sticky sweet chili stir-fry

method.title: Cook noodles
method.text: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.

method.title: Prepare chicken
method.text: Slice chicken into thin strips; season with salt and pepper.

method.title: Cook chicken
method.text: Heat a little oil in a large skillet or wok. Stir-fry chicken 5-6 minutes until cooked and golden. Remove.

method.title: Stir-fry veg
method.text: Add a little oil, sauté garlic and ginger 30 seconds, add peppers and carrot 3-4 minutes. Stir in sweet chili sauce and soy, simmer 1 minute.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.text: Return chicken and noodles to the pan; toss to coat in sauce. Top with scallions and sesame seeds to serve.

sweet-chilli-chicken-noodles.tip: Add a squeeze of lime or a pinch of chili flakes for extra heat!

sweet-chilli-chicken-rice-bowl.title: Sweet Chili Chicken Rice Bowl
sweet-chilli-chicken-rice-bowl.subtitle: Sticky sweet chili chicken bowl

method.title: Cook the rice
method.text: Rinse rice, then cook according to the package instructions (10–12 mins). Set aside.

method.title: Prepare the chicken
method.text: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt, pepper and crushed garlic. Fry in a drizzle of oil until cooked through.

method.title: Add the veg
method.text: Add sliced red bell pepper, broccoli and carrot. Stir-fry 4–5 minutes until tender but still crisp.

method.title: Add the sauce
method.text: Pour in sweet chili sauce and a splash of soy. Stir and simmer 2–3 minutes until everything is coated.

method.title: Serve and finish
method.text: Divide rice between bowls, top with chicken and veg. Finish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds.

sweet-chilli-chicken-rice-bowl.tip: For extra flavor, marinate the chicken in a little sweet chili for 10 minutes before cooking.

sweet-chilli-halloumi-wraps.title: Sweet Chili Halloumi Wraps
sweet-chilli-halloumi-wraps.subtitle: Crispy halloumi with sweet chili

method.title: Cook halloumi
method.text: Slice halloumi into thick strips and pan-fry in a little oil over medium heat until golden on all sides.

method.title: Prep the veggies
method.text: Grate the carrot, slice the cucumber, and tear or shred the lettuce.

method.title: Warm the tortillas
method.text: Heat tortillas in a dry skillet 30 seconds per side or microwave until soft and pliable.

method.title: Fill the wraps
method.text: Layer lettuce, grated carrot, cucumber and golden halloumi. Drizzle sweet chili sauce and mayo or yogurt.

method.title: Roll and serve
method.text: Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and serve immediately.

sweet-chilli-halloumi-wraps.tip: Add a squeeze of lime for extra freshness.
